description: Personal data in a text: whether there is any, and the most sensitive kind

present.instructions: The text contains personal data: an email address, phone number, home address, ID or passport number, card or bank account number, or health details of a person.

kind.instructions: Which kind of personal data does the text contain?

criteria.contact: a person's email address, phone number, or street or postal address
criteria.identity: national ID, passport, social security or driver's licence number, date of birth
criteria.financial: credit card, bank account or IBAN number
criteria.credentials: a password, API key or access token
